title: Simplistic Collection and Labeling Practices Limit the Utility of Benchmark Datasets for Twitter Bot Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Training shallow decision trees and random forests on individual benchmark datasets to demonstrate that simple heuristic rules (e.g., account creation date or whether the account liked tweets) achieve near-state-of-the-art performance, and measuring cross-dataset generalization to show a lack of out-of-sample validity due to collection artifacts.
